verdict.rationale: Managing an authenticator's entries programmatically is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows manual, on-device entry management: QR scanning, swipe-to-edit and swipe-to-delete, and QR-based transfer. Nothing documents an API, CLI or other programmatic surface an agent could use to seed TOTP secrets or store credentials. The GitHub OTP implementations and the PAM module are server-side or library components, not a way to write entries into the app.
